title: Guaranteed Minimum Trade Value Terms Under Northbeam Renew Trade-In
content:
Where a Northbeam Renew Trade-In programme carries a guaranteed minimum trade value, the guarantee is expressed as a percentage of what the device was bought for, stands for a number of months from the purchase, requires the device to be in a stated condition, and either forfeits outright on damage beyond that condition or does not.

| Renew programme | Guaranteed minimum, as a percentage of what the device was bought for | Months from the purchase within which the guarantee stands | Condition the device must be in | Damage beyond that condition forfeits the guarantee outright |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Renew Instant Store Quote | 0 | 0 | not applicable | no |
| Renew Mail In Appraisal | 0 | 0 | not applicable | no |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month | 50 | 12 | good or better, screen unbroken, no liquid ingress | yes |
| Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month | 40 | 24 | good or better, screen unbroken, no liquid ingress | yes |
| Renew Business Asset Buyback | 0 | 0 | not applicable | no |
| Renew Bulk IT Refresh Agreement | 0 | 0 | not applicable | no |

Only the two trade-up programmes carry a guarantee: 50 per cent of what the device was bought for within 12 months on Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twelve Month, and 40 per cent within 24 months on Renew Trade Up Guarantee Twenty Four Month. On both, the condition required is good or better with the screen unbroken and no liquid ingress, and damage beyond that forfeits the guarantee outright. The other four programmes stand at 0 in both figure columns and carry no condition requirement, the guarantee not being part of those programmes.
